claim: For Polygon PoS mainnet over the 005B history, ordering by (block_number, log_index) is exactly equivalent to ordering by (block_timestamp, log_index).

authoritative_source.verification_rule: A header is rejected with ErrInvalidTimestamp when parent.Time + CalculatePeriod(number) > header.Time.

logical_implication: The configured mainnet period is strictly positive throughout the 005B history.
Therefore every valid child block has a strictly greater header timestamp than its parent.
Therefore two different valid Polygon mainnet blocks cannot share the same block timestamp.
Therefore block_number is strictly monotone with the stored block timestamp.
Within a block, log_index is the authoritative observable log sequence.

Consequently the requested true order (block_number, log_index) can be reconstructed without block-number inference as (timestamp, log_index), with tx_hash permitted only after log_index as a deterministic impossible-tie guard.
hard_audit: The corrected lane must fail if two 005B economic rows in one timestamp carry the same log_index, because strict timestamp-to-block uniqueness would then make block/log ordering non-unique for the retained economic-fill population.
parent_pr_preservation: PR #45 artefacts remain byte-identical and are never overwritten.
